audit._percentSemanticNote: 99 = share of COLOR bindings reaching a role-named token (11015/11045; only 30 bind raw color). Across ALL bindings the semantic share is 19% (12379/65045), because dimension and type bind directly to scale primitives by design (shadcn/Tailwind convention), not by omission. Zero unresolved or loose values, so this is a rename-in-place + cleanup job, not a rewrite.

docSurface._note: 86 = 75 component sets + 11 standalone, all carrying verified Figma descriptions; 182/182 variables described too. The gap is code-side: only 1 of 86 (input.md) has a written code doc, and 0 code components exist. The retrofit docs phase adopts the Figma descriptions rather than authoring from scratch.

retrofit._shape: Brownfield in Figma, greenfield in code. Figma is mature (75 sets, 180 variables, 65045 bindings); the repo has no consuming application code (codeSurface: scssColorVars 0, tailwindColorClasses 0, jsColorsUsages 0). Phases 2 (refine), 3 (rebind) and 6.5 (docs) carry real work. Phase 4 (sync) conflicts with the existing working export-tokens.mjs pipeline. Phases 5 (baseline), 6 (code) and 7 (cleanup) are largely empty or blocked because there is no consuming code to protect — see the phase map in the handoff.
retrofit._outOfOrderNote: components/input.tsx was written before entering this sequence (no skill loaded). Assessed low-harm: it binds tokens by name (card, input, ring, destructive, muted, muted-foreground, foreground), so Phase 2 value changes propagate automatically, and no Chromatic baseline existed to invalidate.
